_schema.purpose: Significance gate for fix-first/notify-on-outcome alert routing (docs/fix-first-alert-routing-brief.md). A SUCCESSFUL heal earns a 'closure' DM only if its subject is significant; everything else routes 'digest' (surfaced in the daily CEO digest, not DM'd). Failed heals always 'escalate' regardless of significance — significance never silences an escalation.
_schema.match_rule: Each entry in significant_subjects is a prefix tested against the composite key '<source>:<subject>' (or bare '<source>' when no subject). A trailing '*' or ':' is cosmetic and stripped before the prefix test, so 'heal-credential-registry-drift:*' matches any subject under that source. Default (no match) = routine.
_schema.tunable_note: Membership is Pulse-tunable: add or remove prefixes here to promote/demote a subject without a code change. Routine subjects (install-drift re-installs, sync auto-commit-push retries, daemon-restart heals) are NOT listed — they route 'digest' by omission.
